_comment: Synthetic distractor tool catalog for the tool-search recall@k eval (TOOL_SCALING §3.3). Modeled on real data-app surfaces so BM25 ranking is stressed at the ~100-tool scale the design targets (RAG-MCP methodology). Names must never collide with real registered tools; apps deliberately differ from the real built-in namespaces (sql/context/lineage/skill/agent). Several entries are near-neighbors of real tools (atlan.lineage_graph, metabase.native_query) on purpose.
